description: Open a visible, speaking coach (coach, advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor or another role) in this chat as an MCP App view, for any GoldSeam service. Give the role and your service's own context in any shape; send a coach object from an earlier open_coach to reopen the same coach without resetting anything. The view asks the host for a floating (pip) mode when the host offers one and shows the mode it actually granted, the coach sized to the space the host gives, and what the host supports, including whether spoken replies can reach this chat. You conduct the conversation: speak through the coach with coach_say. GoldSeam keeps nothing; keep the coach object.

actor.description: Optional: the coach's name; the role when omitted

coach.description: The coaching context an earlier open_coach returned (its coach object). Send it to reopen the same coach: same conversation, same size preset and display mode, nothing reset.

context.description: The calling service's own context for the coach (what is being worked on, where it stands), kept with the coaching context. Sent, it replaces the earlier context; omitted when reopening with coach, the coach keeps the context it had

display_mode.description: The mode the view asks the host for; pip (floating) when omitted. The host decides; the view shows what it granted.

role.description: The coach's role, e.g. coach, advisor, counselor, teacher, mentor

size_preset.description: fit: as large as the space allows; natural: the poses' own size, never larger than the space

name: open_coach

coach.description: The coaching context: coach_id (GoldAvatar's conversation), actor, role, seat, page_url, feed_after (where the coach view starts reading GoldAvatar's feed), picture (the poses the coach view draws the coach from, with their proportions and where their files are, from GoldAvatar's pose manifest), voice (GoldAvatar's voice service), size_preset, display_mode, the caller's context, and replaced (previous_coach_id, why) when status is replaced: the earlier coaching context was closed or unknown to GoldAvatar Messaging, so a new one was opened

title: Open Coach
